text.en:
To perpetuate the memory of the late Hon. Pedro Guevara, a former Resident Commissioner in
the united States, a street called "Mangahan" in the district oi Santa Cruz, City of Manila, which name does
not awaken any recollection in the mind of the Filipino people, shall hereafter be known as Pedro Guevara

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 19, 1938.
